en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Hussain bin Ibrahim bin Ahmad bin Hisham al-Maktab, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Ja’far al-Asadi, that he said: We were told by Musa bin Imran al-Nakha’i, from his paternal uncle, Hussain ibn Yazid, that he said: I was told by Ali bin Ghurab, that he said: I was told by the Best of all named Ja’far, Ja’far bin Muhammed, from his father, from his grandfather, from his gather, peace be upon them, that he said:
The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Trim the mustaches, leave the beards and do not resemble (yourselves with) the Zoroastrians.
